name: Rise to standing
short_description: Move from a stable seated position to standing with controlled balance.
self_assessment: I can rise from a stable seat to standing once without another person's help.
description: Move from a stable seated position to standing with controlled balance. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
